Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that uses the pyaedt library to create a 2D Extractor CPWG (coplanar waveguide with ground) design and run a simulation. The code should import the necessary libraries, set the non-graphical mode, launch AEDT and 2D Extractor, define variables, create primitives, create a signal, create a coplanar ground, create a reference ground plane, create a dielectric, create a conformal coating, assign a conductor to the signal, create a reference ground, assign the Huray model on the signal, create the setup, analyze it, plot solution data, save the project and close AEDT.

message.content:
```python
from pyaedt import Hfss3dLayout, Desktop
from pyaedt import generate_unique_name
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Set non-graphical mode
non_graphical = True

# Launch AEDT and 2D Extractor
desktop = Desktop(specified_version="2023.2", non_graphical=non_graphical, new_desktop_session=True)
extractor = Hfss3dLayout(projectname="CPWG_2D_Extractor", designname="CPWG_Design", solution_type="2D Extractor")

# Define variables
extractor["w"] = "0.5mm"      # Signal width
extractor["s"] = "0.3mm"      # Gap
extractor["g"] = "2mm"        # Ground width
extractor["l"] = "10mm"       # Length
extractor["h"] = "0.8mm"      # Substrate height
extractor["t"] = "0.035mm"    # Conductor thickness
extractor["eps_r"] = "4.4"    # Dielectric constant
extractor["cc_t"] = "0.01mm"  # Conformal coating thickness

# Create primitives
origin_x = "0mm"
origin_y = "0mm"

# Signal trace
signal_name = generate_unique_name("Signal")
signal = extractor.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[origin_x, origin_y],
    dimension_list=["w", "l"],
    name=signal_name,
    layer_name="TOP"
)

# Left ground
left_ground_name = generate_unique_name("LeftGround")
left_ground = extractor.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["-g-s-w", origin_y],
    dimension_list=["g", "l"],
    name=left_ground_name,
    layer_name="TOP"
)

# Right ground
right_ground_name = generate_unique_name("RightGround")
right_ground = extractor.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["w+s", origin_y],
    dimension_list=["g", "l"],
    name=right_ground_name,
    layer_name="TOP"
)

# Reference ground plane (bottom layer)
ref_ground_name = generate_unique_name("RefGround")
ref_ground = extractor.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=["-g-s-w", "-0.1mm"],
    dimension_list=["2*g+2*s+w", "l+0.2mm"],
    name=ref_ground_name,
    layer_name="BOTTOM"
)

# Create dielectric
dielectric_name = generate_unique_name("Substrate")
extractor.modeler.create_dielectric(
    position=["-g-s-w", "-0.1mm"],
    dimension_list=["2*g+2*s+w", "l+0.2mm", "h"],
    material="FR4_epoxy",
    name=dielectric_name
)
extractor.modeler.layers.add_layer("COATING", "ConformalCoating", thickness="cc_t")

# Create conformal coating
coating_name = generate_unique_name("Coating")
extractor.modeler.create_rectangle(
    position=[origin_x, origin_y],
    dimension_list=["w", "l"],
    name=coating_name,
    layer_name="COATING"
)

# Assign conductor to signal
extractor.assign_single_conductor(signal_name, signal_type="Signal")
extractor.assign_single_conductor(left_ground_name, signal_type="ReferenceGround")
extractor.assign_single_conductor(right_ground_name, signal_type="ReferenceGround")
extractor.assign_single_conductor(ref_ground_name, signal_type="ReferenceGround", layer_name="BOTTOM")

# Assign Huray model to signal
extractor.assign_huray_surface(signal_name, radius=0.5e-6, ratio=2.0)

# Create setup
setup = extractor.create_setup("Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "10GHz"
setup.update()

# Analyze
extractor.analyze()

# Plot solution data
solution_data = extractor.post.get_solution_data(
    expressions=["Z0"],
    context="Original",
    sweep_variable="Freq"
)
plt.plot(solution_data.sweeps["Freq"], solution_data.data_real("Z0"))
plt.xlabel("Frequency (Hz)")
plt.ylabel("Z0 (Ohm)")
plt.title("Characteristic Impedance vs Frequency")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

# Save project and close AEDT
extractor.save_project()
extractor.release_desktop(close_projects=True, close_desktop=True)
```
